# Font test fixture

`Ahem.ttf.base64` is the base64 encoding of W3C's Ahem TrueType test font from web-platform-tests commit `c5e6a81de61c36d29f8ef315e6b5e7813d86205b` (`fonts/Ahem.ttf`). Ahem was developed by Todd Fahrner and Myles C. Maxfield for predictable CSS tests. It is public domain; CC0 applies where public-domain dedication is not recognized.

Source: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/c5e6a81de61c36d29f8ef315e6b5e7813d86205b/fonts/Ahem.ttf

License/provenance: https://www.w3.org/Style/CSS/Test/Fonts/Ahem/

Tests decode this text fixture in memory. It is never included in application or offline production bundles, and it is not ITC Flora.
